name: Stone Creek Golf Club
architects: Peter Jacobsen and Jim Hardy (opened 2002; OGA lists 2003)

dtm.source: DOGAMI lidar DIGITAL_TERRAIN_MODEL_MOSAIC (bare earth), exportImage at 1 m in EPSG:32610, box x 533024-534504 / y 5015560-5017040, downloaded by the developer 2026-10-19 (GitHub release stone-creek-data, exportImage.8.tiff)

chm.source: DOGAMI lidar CANOPY_HEIGHT_MODEL_MOSAIC (highest hit minus bare earth), exportImage at 1 m in EPSG:32610, same box, downloaded by the developer 2026-10-19 (GitHub release stone-creek-data, exportImage.9.tiff)
chm.label: DOGAMI canopy height model

world.note: OSM boundary way/188382554 bbox (1,011 x 967 m) + ~120 m scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred: 134 m of scenery west and east, 157 m south, 156 m north

scorecard_source: Club scorecard image supplied by the developer (release stone-creek-data, Screenshot.2026-10-18.232154.png, copy in reference/stone_creek/scorecard.png), 2026-10-19. Hole sums match the printed Out/In/Total for all four tee sets. Full card in scorecard_full.csv
attribution: Elevation and canopy height: Oregon Department of Geology and Mineral Industries (DOGAMI) lidar
notes: Phase 1 decisions (developer, 2026-10-19): Blue tees; every water hazard red; out of bounds = the OSM course boundary; the driving range (south-east of hole 9, not mapped in OSM) is not out of bounds.
tee_shot_note: tee_shot_margin_m: the tee-shot tree check (pipeline/tee_shots.py) keeps the ball 0.5 m clear of each crown; without it the check passed hole 15 by 0.1 m while the game's ball clipped a 43 m fir 49 m out (course chat, 2026-10-19)
